name: a value slides along a number line to its new target
looks: A horizontal number line of small tick values sits under a bold claim. A dot marked "FROM" one value slides along the line to a new, larger value labelled "NEW", in the accent green, while a detail card beside it updates its own figures and a bullet list of reasons fades in underneath.
build: easing-graph-draw's number-line pattern: the dot's x position tweens from the old tick to the new tick on power3.out, with the value label counting through the intermediate numbers as it travels; the side card and its bullet list key in with annotated-diagram-overlay-style staggered callouts right after the dot lands.
sound: A rising tick-tick as the dot travels, a soft chime as it lands, a tick per bullet.
prompt: Under a bold claim, slide a marked value along a number line to a new target value in the accent colour, with the number counting through as it travels. Land beside it on a detail card that updates its own figures and reveals a short bulleted rationale right after the value settles.
